# Bespoke Edge

> > Denver's premier custom menswear tailoring service offering bespoke suits, shirts, tuxedos, and formal wear for weddings and everyday occasions.

Bespoke Edge is a family-run custom tailoring business with showrooms in Denver and Fort Collins, Colorado, specializing in made-to-measure menswear. The company serves customers across Colorado and beyond, offering inclusive services for all clients including LGBTQ couples and those seeking elopement attire.

## Shop & Products

- [Shop](https://bespokeedge.com/shop): Main shop page for custom suits, shirts, pants, vests, jackets, tuxedos.
- [Custom Suits](https://bespokeedge.com/shop/suits): Custom suits product category with fine materials and precise measurements.
- [Custom Shirts](https://bespokeedge.com/shop/shirts): Custom dress shirts tailored to exact measurements in short and long sleeves.
- [Custom Tuxedos](https://bespokeedge.com/shop/tuxedos): Custom tuxedos for weddings and black-tie events in Denver, Fort Collins.
- [Custom Jackets](https://bespokeedge.com/shop/jackets): Custom jackets and sport coats for casual and formal settings.
- [Custom Pants](https://bespokeedge.com/shop/pants): Perfect-fitting custom pants in modern fabrics for Denver, Fort Collins.
- [Custom Vests](https://bespokeedge.com/shop/vests): Custom vests for weddings and everyday wear in Denver, Fort Collins.
- [Tailoring and Alterations](https://bespokeedge.com/shop/tailoring-and-alterations): Tailoring and alterations services at Denver and Fort Collins showrooms.
- [All Products](https://shop.bespokeedge.com/collections/all): All products collection including gift cards and garment care accessories.
- [Gift Cards](https://shop.bespokeedge.com/products/bespoke-edge-gift-card): Digital gift cards for custom clothing with suggested amounts.
